NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Show in Android Auto
patches.description: Lists the app in the Android Auto launcher and shows its full interface on the car screen while parked.

options.title: Keep media services
options.description: Keep the app's media browser service, so music and podcast apps keep their Android Auto audio player. Android Auto may then show that player instead of the full app.

options.title: Fill the car screen
options.description: Remove portrait-only locks, so screens that only work upright fill the wide car display.
